description: Issue terms read from issue documents, one entry per (secid, term, date), each with evidence (WEB-18; TDM brief R9 HS8 floater conventions, HS9 call schedules of perpetuals, HS10 dated offers; review P1-6 / P1-9). Loaded by job bond_terms_curated into ref.bond_curated_term and, per term, ref.bond_rate_formula (source curated, status curated: ref.bond_rate_formula_resolved then prefers it over the inferred MOEX / Cbonds formula), ref.bond_offer (source curated) and the static snapshot (replacement_bond, basis document). Terms: floater_formula {benchmark (KEY_RATE | RUONIA | RUONIA_3M | ...), benchmark_raw, spread_bp, multiplier, lag_days, averaging, floor_pct, cap_pct, fixing_day, variable_rate_type}; call / offer {date, type (call | put; offer only), price_pct, window_start, window_end}; replacement_bond {replacement_bond (bool), replaces (ISIN of the replaced eurobond, optional)}. Decimals are strings. Evidence (all required except page and curated_by): document_url (e-disclosure / NSD / issuer site), document_title, page, extracted_text (the clause quoted verbatim), retrieved_on (YYYY-MM-DD), curated_by. Optional isin is cross-checked against ref.bond. Never enter a value the quoted clause does not state.
